title: microsorum cuspidatum
intro: Microsorum cuspidatum, commonly known as Lion's Foot, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. The plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine to provide several health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Microsorum cuspidatum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Microsorum cuspidatum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
